title: Stage quality
text: Shapes that alias badly (thin diagonals, small circles, rotated squares, stars, checkerboards, hairlines, sub-pixel edges) and abutting-fill elements, drawn with BitmapData.draw at every stage quality and compared with AIR at the same quality: over the whole scene, over the anti-aliased edges, and for seam bleed.
notes: The edge scores measure how close the anti-aliasing is to AIR's at each quality; they have no limit. LOW is far apart by nature: an aliased edge pixel is either in or out, and AIR and Cairo decide differently on the boundary.
The "supersampling off" run only reports: it shows the seam bleed that OpenFL's Cairo supersampling removes.
